0.original: Tierney believes you are ready to join a guildhest.

1.original: Guildhests are special operations organized by Adventurers' Guilds and overseen by battlewardens. To learn more about what guildhests entail, speak with Battlewarden Ribald.

2.original: Battlewarden Ribald explains that guildhests will test your ability to work with others to achieve a common goal. Unless you are content to conduct your adventures forever alone, it may be in your best interests to participate in these operations at least once.

48.original: Should you be interested in a challenge quite unlike your average levequest, you might consider joining a guildhest.

49.original: If you wish to know more, pray speak with Battlewarden Ribald outside yonder tent. I will inform him of your success against the anoles so that there are no doubts as to your abilities.

50.original: I was told a stalwart adventurer would be along shortly. I take it that is you? Then permit me to tell you all about our current operations.

51.original: Wait... Might this be your first time participating in a guildhest? I remember my first hest. It was the night of my twentieth nameday. My fellow guildmates invited me to join them in the slaying of a family of peistes who were stealing chocobo eggs from Bentbranch Meadows.

52.original: The moment we arrived, one of the terrible beasts immediately turned to me and charged. The thing was thrice my size and had already maimed several chocobokeeps.

53.original: There was no way I could win, so I simply froze and waited for the end. But that's when I remembered that I was not alone. My friends rallied around me, and together we defeated the peistes! That, my friend, is what a guildhest is truly about.

54.original: What say you, friend? Care to experience a hest for yourself?

55.original: You have unlocked the Duty Finder! This feature allows you to undertake multiplayer duties without having to form a party on your own.

56.original: To bring up the Duty Finder interface, select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty Finder<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> under <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Duty<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> from the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>main menu<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
